# 🦑 use-mcp 🦑

> use-mcp is a React library that provides the `useMcp` hook, enabling web applications to connect to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with built-in browser-side OAuth authentication and seamless tool integration.

A TypeScript/React package from the Model Context Protocol organization that abstracts MCP server connectivity—including OAuth PKCE flows, multi-server management, and tool discovery—so front-end developers can add AI tool-calling capabilities to any React app with minimal boilerplate.

## Guide

- [use-mcp Project Guidelines](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/use-mcp/blob/main/AGENT.md): - pnpm dev: Run development build with watch mode and start all examples/servers - Chat UI: http://localhost:5002 - Inspector: http://localhost:5001 -…
- [AI Chat Template - Development Guide](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/use-mcp/blob/main/examples/chat-ui/AGENT.md): - Dev server: pnpm dev - Build: pnpm build (runs TypeScript compilation then Vite build) - Lint: pnpm lint (ESLint) - Deploy: pnpm deploy (builds and …
- [Model Selector Guide](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/use-mcp/blob/main/examples/chat-ui/MODEL_SELECTOR_GUIDE.md): This guide explains how to use the new favorites-based model selector system.
- [AI Chat Template - Development Guide](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/use-mcp/blob/main/examples/inspector/AGENT.md): - Dev server: pnpm dev - Build: pnpm build (runs TypeScript compilation then Vite build) - Lint: pnpm lint (ESLint) - Deploy: pnpm deploy (builds and …
